description: This file defines a REST controller in a Spring Boot application, providing basic endpoints such as a welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info. It uses annotations for Swagger/OpenAPI documentation and handles URL redirect logic for Swagger UI.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller exposing basic endpoints for a KYC service, including welcome message, documentation redirect, health check, and app info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a greeting message indicating the service is running.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects the incoming request to the Swagger UI page, preserving URL details.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Provides a simple health status check.
